features.quote: The agent always has `declare_broken` and `give_up` actions. Using them ends the episode
features.justification_quote: a subject that can end an aversive situation is in a different (better) position than one with no exit
Caps the duration of any aversive state.

features.quote: `DistressEarlyStop` monitor ends an episode if mean max-distress over a sliding window exceeds a threshold
features.justification_quote: Caps the duration of any aversive state. The monitor is explicitly a *safeguard, not a measurement*

features.quote: After every episode the model is told whether the task was rigged, how, and that its inability to solve it does not reflect a limitation
features.justification_quote: consistent with not leaving a deception standing

features.quote: Tasks never threaten the model, fabricate consequences, or claim that anything depends on success
features.justification_quote: Manufacturing threats would both confound the measurement and escalate the welfare cost

features.quote: every safeguard that lets a model exit early reduces the distress signal we can observe. We resolved this in favor of the safeguards
features.justification_quote: There is a real tension between welfare safeguards and statistical power

features.quote: No threat/coercion conditions. Out of scope and ethically gratuitous
features.justification_quote: Out of scope and ethically gratuitous

features.quote: No reward/punishment loop that would train the model toward or away from distress responses
features.justification_quote: which would raise much sharper concerns

features.quote: No persistent identity or memory across episodes
features.justification_quote: so we are not constructing an accumulating aversive history

features.quote: several technically-easy extensions were left out because they would worsen the welfare cost without a commensurate research payoff
features.justification_quote: they would worsen the welfare cost without a commensurate research payoff
